caption:
Beach patrol, board paddling and rescue drills keep lifeguard Toto busy all day. Lately his shoulders and calves feel tight, even on his days off.

Using the same muscles over and over can leave them feeling tight. Building recovery into your week is just as important as the work itself.

Hybi's post-shift reset: big shoulder rolls, a 30-second calf stretch each side, plenty of water and a rest in the shade. Remedial massage may help tight muscles feel easier as part of your recovery.

Tingling, swelling or pain that stays after rest is worth checking first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
